scope.description: Participant-eligibility check of one verification future in one leader generation under fixed three-voter plus one-nonvoter membership. Compare nonvoter-only remote positive support against a permitted remote-voter control. This is a necessary-condition check, not an eventual-success or all-voters requirement.
assumptions: Operation identity and worker suffrage are independently recorded and fixed during each comparison.
No remote voter contribution is inferred from connectivity alone: pending registrations, reply delivery and alternate successful append paths must be accounted for.
The executed artifact must declare whether authority/configuration prefix is real or supplied. Supplied state yields only a conditional local result.
Network loss/delay is non-Byzantine; replies used as positive support must come from actual implementation or be identified as a conditional substitute.
excluded: A later leader election or stale FSM read unless separately observed.
Configuration transitions, self removal, shutdown and disaster recovery during the comparison.
General liveness failure from an unfinished verification or tool timeout.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: Embed InmemTransport and delay AppendEntries calls before real delivery using channels; do not change requests or responses.
Explicitly disable optional pipelining via ErrPipelineReplicationNotSupported; ordinary retry/fallback and heartbeat remain real.
Observe transport return fields and public futures; use MockFSM from captured testing support.
Cut schedule off after 600 ms independently of forbidden success; missing result remains unknown. Release all gates and shut down all nodes.

plan_uncertainties: No broader stale-read or later-leader endpoint is measured.
Counts are transport delivery observations, not instrumentation inside vote(); absence of any eligible reply after complete two-loop quiescence is the relevant discriminator.
An independently missing case is reported incomplete and cannot supply a holds result.
grounding_unresolved: Documentation does not define a linearization point or complete read protocol; these remain outside the local eligibility claim.
Measurement of producer identity, registration and terminal public result remains required.
Scheduling that misses quiescence cutoff yields setup failure, not evidence. Missing verification completion emits only an incomplete diagnostic, not a result.
A result proves the local participant-eligibility proposition only. No competing authority or stale application read is observed.
Successful reply count is an upper bound on consumed support; absence proves no voter consumption after quiescence. The permitted control releases only the voter, excluding nonvoter substitution.
